build_qei_source: build a QeiSource instance from a QeiSourceConfig to compute collisional ion-electron heat exchange
build_runtime_params: build RuntimeParams from QeiSourceConfig with a given time value and Qei_multiplier
compute_qei: compute the collisional ion-electron heat exchange coefficient using _model_based_qei

review_qei_source: review QeiSource class and its get_qei method for implicit and explicit solver terms
